brief: A macOS dashboard for developers: drag any project folder (Node, Rust, Tauri, Python, Java, Go) and get metrics, dev servers, builds and the Git history at a glance. Calm, technical, honest — no hype.
criteria: Success: reads as a D with a mooring bollard crown at 16 px, works in one colour, distinct from dev-tool clichés (brackets, cursors, gears).

concepts.name: Bita amarre
concepts.idea: A D whose roof swells into a mooring bollard crown — your project, tied to the dock.
rationale: Letterform D doubles as app icon and favicon
The bollard crown owns the dock metaphor without nautical clichés (no anchors, no waves)
Single-path geometry: audit 100/100, holds at 16 px

recommendation: Bita amarre — the only direction that is unmistakably ours: a letter that is also an object, and the object is exactly what the product does.
next_steps: App icon set + favicon shipped into the Tauri bundle
Optional: custom wordmark to complete the lockup
